environment.description: Process launched via systemd unit with RootDirectory=/var/app/sandbox (chroot). The sandbox directory tree contains ONLY: /uploads/ (writable), /extracted/ (writable), /server (the binary, read-only bind-mount), /lib/ and /lib64/ (minimal shared libraries, read-only). The chroot has no /etc, no /proc, no /sys, no device nodes. ProtectSystem=strict and PrivateDevices=yes are set. The systemd unit also sets ReadWritePaths=/var/app/sandbox/uploads:/var/app/sandbox/extracted and uses DynamicUser=yes which maps to a transient UID with no supplementary groups. The process runs with CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE only (CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE). SystemCallFilter=@system-service applied.
